emma: Heads-up   HelioQuantum case draft is ready for final approvals. They signed off on the narrative but want the quote tightened and translations for DE/FR. Can legal confirm quote release + logo permission by Fri EOD?
ryan: Paste the exact quote they want published so legal can review.
emma: Their comms suggested: "Redwood reduced our inference p99 latency by ~58% and cut per-token costs by nearly half."
leah: Legal redlines: change '~58%' -> 'approximately 58%'; change 'nearly half' -> 'approximately 50%'. Need explicit email that grants Redwood permission to publish the quote, logo, and translated versions. No raw ARR or MRR.
theo: Design wants svg logo, headshot, and one product screenshot. I'll prepare a neutral hero slide titled 'Inference at scale' and swap brand assets after approval.
priya: Ops: we'll route webinar leads to EU_AE queue and tag @amanda. Hidden form field campaign=helioquantum_case. Nurture: teaser + reminder + replay.
amanda: Got it   I'll map SF campaign HQ-07-26 and set lead owner rule to EU-West.
emma: Also requested a 10s CTO clip for the landing page. Asked them to send the exact publish date.
legal-bot: Checklist: verbatim quote, email release with publish date & logo terms, permission to translate and embed video. Legal can clear after email arrives.
calendar-bot: Tentative event created   "HelioQuantum case interview" Jul 8 09:00 UTC   invites: emma,ryan,theo,priaya,amanda
leah: On standby. If approval lands by Thu EOD, legal can sign off for Jul 15 publish. :thumbsup:
emma: Thanks team   will update once comms replies. :pray:
